We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 1914386) to the given molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O). The task: "make_3_lvl2-apply_template-1: return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_3_lvl2-template_search-1 to the molecule below". So we need to apply the template to the molecule, get possible precursor sets.

We have template_id 1914386 and mapped_rxn given. We need to apply template to target molecule (the product). Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles = given SMILES, template_id = 1914386.
